units.source_text: 这种话本来不应在当事人面前说出来的，可柏木竟然好像身边没有小姐的存在，满不在乎地说了出来。

en.t: Such words should never have been spoken in front of the person concerned, yet Kashiwagi said them without the slightest concern, as if the young lady beside him did not exist.

units.source_text: 小姐听了这番话后，表情毫无变化。

en.t: After hearing those words, the young lady's expression did not change at all.

units.source_text: 她那柔嫩的脖颈上挂着由陶片串成的蓝色项链，

en.t: Around her delicate neck hung a blue necklace strung together from pieces of pottery,

units.source_text: 以阴沉的天空为背景，她的鬈曲秀发的轮廓使她那过分鲜明的容貌变得朦胧了。

en.t: against the gloomy sky, the outline of her curled, beautiful hair blurred the excessive sharpness of her features.

units.source_text: 正因为眼睛过度湿润，惟有她的眼睛才给人留下一种活生生的赤裸裸的印象。

en.t: Precisely because her eyes were too moist, only her eyes left an impression that was vividly alive and naked.

units.source_text: 她那带轻化的嘴角像平时一样微微地张开，两片薄唇之间露出了一挑细尖、晶亮而洁白的牙齿。

en.t: The corners of her mouth, softened slightly, were parted a little as usual, and between her thin lips showed a row of slender, pointed, shining white teeth.

units.source_text: 它给人小动物牙齿一般的感觉。

en.t: They gave the impression of the teeth of a small animal.
